tool_call.invocation: direct (tools.codeintel.codeintel_grep), one call, no catalog lookup needed this turn

parity.verdict: the 30 returned CodeIntel rows are exactly rg rows 1-30 in the same order; the 70-row difference is the server's hard result_limit=30 with no pagination (truncated=true), not a difference in matching semantics
parity.NO-VERDICT: whether the remaining 70 rows are byte-identical to rg cannot be observed through this tool at any limit - NO-VERDICT by design of the 30-row ceiling

task_usefulness.verdict: useful, precision-complete on the returned page, incomplete in coverage
task_usefulness.precision: 100/100 rows in the rg population begin with a real log call (log( or self.log()); zero prose/comment false positives, verified on the full population
task_usefulness.reaches: panel open/close/show/hide/state sites plus the CAPTION_PAINT emitter at :9497
recall_gaps: self.log_fn(...) contains no literal 'log(' and is invisible to this pattern - that is how HOTKEY_PRESSED is emitted at :3534
multi-line log(...) calls with the term on a continuation line are unreachable by any single-line regex
70 of 100 sites cannot be enumerated (30-row clamp, no offset/pagination)

no_verdict_fields.mcp_source_revision: NO-VERDICT - the codeintel_grep envelope exposes effective_scope, result_limit, pattern_mode and truncated, but no version or commit field, so a source revision is not observable
no_verdict_fields.full_set_identity: NO-VERDICT - only 30 of 100 rows are returned; set equality with rg is unobservable

side_effects: none: no source edits, no index refresh or bootstrap, no build, no tests
